normalized_spec.goal: Add rate limiting to public user profile API

identified_risks: External dependency latency impacting P99 API response time
IP spoofing via unvalidated proxy headers
risk_and_tradeoffs.mitigation_applied: Fail-open circuit breaker + verified via automated pytest sandbox
risk_and_tradeoffs.trade_offs: Fixed-window counter allows brief boundary bursts vs. Sliding Window memory overhead.

artifacts.openapi_contract:
openapi: 3.0.0
paths:
  /api/v1/users/{id}:
    get:
      responses:
        '429':
          description: Too Many Requests
artifacts.documentation:
# Rate Limiting Architecture
- Strategy: Fixed-window counter in Redis (60s TTL).
- Failure Mode: Fail-open if Redis is unreachable.
